Headline: Loop-bound Orange Line Service Running with Delays
ShortDescription: Orange Line trains are experiencing a service disruption at Midway due to signal problems..

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Orange Line trains are experiencing a service disruption at Midway due to signal problems.

Bus shuttles have been requested from Midway to Western to provide connecting service through the affected area.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#63 63rd

#54B South Cicero

#47 47th

Personnel are working to restore normal service. Allow extra travel time.
